text: Establish agent identity with ERC-8004 registration
description: Register Bowman agent with unique ERC-8004 identity linked to operator wallet. This creates verifiable onchain identity enabling trust-based ecosystems, reputation systems, and agent-to-agent collaboration. Includes: agent identity creation, operator wallet association, ERC-8004 registration transaction on appropriate chain.

supportingConnections.explanation: The concrete integration attempt belongs beneath the broader ERC-8004 identity direction; both remain cancelled context pending external demand.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026: speculative on-chain registration inherited from the unvalidated ERC-8004 hackathon branch. Wallet identity and registration add operational/security burden without a current user or partner need. Retained as cancelled context so it is not recreated casually.
